:::{#def-term-vector}
#### Term vector

Consider a model whose mean is a linear combination
of $p$ terms $t_1(x), \ldots, t_p(x)$ of the covariate value,
such as $1$, $x$ and $x^2$.
The **term vector** $\termvec{i}$ of observation $i$
is the column of its terms:

$$
\termvec{i} \eqdef \tp{\paren{t_1(x_i), \ldots, t_p(x_i)}}.
$$ {#eq-term-vector}

:::
